column1: # Documented functions of gmodule/rel_quiz.prx (see re/documented.tsv for the columns; registry ids carry the module prefix, addresses here do not).

column3: summary

Module start of rel_quiz: when arg is 0 registers the quiz scene with system_scene_register(world_quiz_scene_main 0x00000038, world_quiz_scene_end 0x000000e4, 0x0000f3a0). Returns 0. Side effects: the scene registration. No direct caller (module entry point). Same code as rel_shop shop_module_start.

Scene start of the quiz mini-game (scene 0x18): hides the loading overlay, runs world_quiz_init and, when its return register is non-zero (Ghidra types the init as void; hypothesis: it holds the 1 just stored to 0x0000f3ac, confidence medium), installs world_quiz_draw_frame (0x1b4) and world_quiz_leave (0x1e4) as frame callbacks, then loops world_quiz_update_frame / system_wait_frame until it reports completion; afterwards installs the no-op callbacks, shows the loading overlay, waits one frame and returns from scene 0x18 (system_scene_return(0x18, 0)). No return value. Side effects: everything the game does, scene return. No direct caller (registered as the scene start callback by world_quiz_module_start).
Empty scene end callback. No return value. No side effects. No direct caller (registered as the scene end callback by world_quiz_module_start).

Sets the thread attribute 0x4000, creates a 4 MiB heap on the module memory at module +0xf3c0 (pointer 0x0040f3c0) and registers it for deletion, allocates the 0x30-byte game object on it (world_quiz_game_construct; pointer 0x0000f3b0), runs world_quiz_game_init on it and sets the draw flag 0x0000f3ac to 1. No return value. Side effects: heap creation, 0x0040f3c0, 0x0000f3b0, 0x0000f3ac. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_scene_main).

Runs one step of world_quiz_game_update on the game object 0x0000f3b0; when it reports completion clears the draw flag 0x0000f3ac. Returns true when the mini-game is finished. Side effects: through the update; 0x0000f3ac. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_scene_main).

Frame callback: while the draw flag 0x0000f3ac is set draws the game (world_quiz_game_draw on 0x0000f3b0). No return value. Side effects: GE display lists. No direct caller (installed by world_quiz_scene_main through system_scene_set_frame_callback).

Leave callback: terminates the game (world_quiz_game_term), deletes the game object through its vtable (+0x2c, slot +8, flag 1), clears 0x0000f3b0, queries the heap's free/used sizes (results unused), unregisters and frees the module heap 0x0040f3c0. No return value. Side effects: frees all module memory. No direct caller (installed by world_quiz_scene_main through system_scene_set_frame_callback).

Allocates a 0x20-byte base task from the module heap (world_quiz_task_construct) and stores it in 0x0040f3c4 as the head of the update list (+0x08) and draw list (+0x14). No return value. Side effects: heap allocation, 0x0040f3c4. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_game_init).

Walks the update list from head 0x0040f3c4 (+0x08 next links) and calls vtable slot +0x10 (update) of every task whose update-enable byte +0x18 is 1. No return value. Side effects: whatever the task updates do. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_game_update).
Empty function (hypothesis: the update entry of the base task vtable 0x0000f2b4, confidence medium). No return value. No side effects. No direct caller (reached through a function pointer).

Walks the draw list from head 0x0040f3c4 (+0x14 next links) and calls vtable slot +0x14 (draw) of every task whose draw-enable byte +0x19 is 1. No return value. Side effects: GE display lists. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_game_draw).
Empty function (hypothesis: the draw entry of the base task vtable 0x0000f2b4, confidence medium). No return value. No side effects. No direct caller (reached through a function pointer).

Repeatedly takes the first task of the update list, detaches it with its detach hook (world_quiz_task_detach) and deletes it through vtable slot +8, until the list is empty; then deletes the list head 0x0040f3c4 the same way and clears the pointer. No return value. Side effects: frees every task, 0x0040f3c4. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_game_term).

column2: void world_quiz_task_link_update_list(int *task, int priority, int before_equal)
column3: Inserts task into the doubly linked update list of 0x0040f3c4 ordered by ascending priority (task +0 priority, +4 prev, +8 next): with before_equal 0 it goes after tasks of equal priority, otherwise before them. No return value. Side effects: list links. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_task_attach).

column2: void world_quiz_task_link_draw_list(void *task, int priority, int before_equal)
column3: Same ordered insertion into the draw list of 0x0040f3c4 using task +0x0c priority, +0x10 prev, +0x14 next. No return value. Side effects: list links. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_task_attach).

column2: void world_quiz_task_attach(void *task, int update_priority, int draw_priority, int before_equal, char call_hook)
column3: When call_hook is 1 calls the task's attach hook (vtable slot +0x0c), then links it into the update list (world_quiz_task_link_update_list) and the draw list (world_quiz_task_link_draw_list) at the given priorities. The fifth argument travels in t0. No return value. Side effects: list links, the hook. Callers: 4 (world_quiz_create_tasks, world_quiz_game_update, world_quiz_create_title, world_quiz_create_combo_popup).
Empty function (hypothesis: the attach hook of the base task vtable 0x0000f2b4, confidence medium). No return value. No side effects. No direct caller (reached through a function pointer).

Searches the update list of 0x0040f3c4 for task and, when found, unlinks it and clears its priority, prev and next words (+0, +4, +8). No return value. Side effects: list links. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_task_detach).
Searches the draw list of 0x0040f3c4 for task and, when found, unlinks it and clears +0x0c, +0x10, +0x14. No return value. Side effects: list links. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_task_detach).

Unlinks task from the update and draw lists and, when call_hook is 1, calls its detach hook (vtable slot +0x18). No return value. Side effects: list links, the hook. Callers: 6 (world_quiz_task_destroy, world_quiz_destroy_task_manager, world_quiz_destroy_tasks, world_quiz_title_update, ...).
Empty function (hypothesis: the detach hook of the base task vtable 0x0000f2b4, confidence medium). No return value. No side effects. No direct caller (reached through a function pointer).

Base task constructor: sets the vtable +0x1c to 0x0000f2b4, clears the update link triple (+0..+8) and draw link triple (+0x0c..+0x14) and sets the update-enable (+0x18) and draw-enable (+0x19) bytes to 1. Returns task. Side effects: writes task. Callers: 7 (world_quiz_create_task_manager, world_quiz_wheel_construct, world_quiz_title_construct, world_quiz_main_construct, ...).
Zeroes three words (priority, prev, next). No return value. Side effects: writes links. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_task_construct).

Base task destructor: when task is non-null resets its vtable to 0x0000f2b4 and frees it (operator_delete) when flags > 0. Returns task. Side effects: may free task. Callers: 6 (world_quiz_wheel_destruct, world_quiz_title_destruct, world_quiz_main_destruct, world_quiz_popup_destruct, ...).

Initialises the 0x30-byte game object: releases all sound banks and loads tracks 0x2d4 and 0x2c8, clears the fields (+0 loader, +4 state, +8 black-screen byte, +0x0c..+0x28), creates the task manager, allocates the 0x3c-byte archive loader (world_quiz_loader_construct, cleared by world_quiz_loader_clear; game +0), initialises the 3D render state on GE layer 0, starts loading archive slot 0 and the language UI slot (world_quiz_get_lang_ui_slot) and starts a 1-frame black fade out. No return value. Side effects: audio banks, heap allocations, archive loads, fade. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_init).

Allocates and attaches the play tasks: the 0x16eec-byte main quiz task (world_quiz_main_construct; game +0x18; priorities 0/0), a 0x30-byte task (world_quiz_hud_construct; +0x1c; 1/1) and the 0x4c-byte card wheel (world_quiz_wheel_construct; +0x24; 2/2), each with its attach hook. No return value. Side effects: heap allocations, game fields, task lists. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_game_update).

For each non-null task in game +0x18, +0x1c, +0x24, +0x28 and +0x20 detaches it with its hook, deletes it through vtable slot +8 and clears the field; then frees the CIP buffer +0x0c. No return value. Side effects: frees tasks and the buffer, game fields. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_game_update).

Per-frame quiz state machine on game +0x04, after reading the pad and running the task updates: 0 stops all sounds, 1-frame black fade out, black screen on, -> 1; 1 waits for the archive loader to be idle, creates the play tasks, loads the language result slot, allocates a 1 MiB buffer (+0x0c) and opens the card8 CIP reader on it (+0x10), creates title kind 0 (+0x20), sets a 60-frame timer (+0x14), plays sound 0x7ac2, -> 2; 2 counts the timer down, clears the black screen, pauses the title's update at its frame 0xd until the CIP reader is ready, the loader idle and the timer expired, then resumes it, -> 3; 3 when the title is done destroys it and starts a 16-frame white fade in, -> 4; 4 when the fade is done clears the power flags, -> 5; 5 when the main task's finished byte is set requests the CIP reader to stop, -> 6; 6 when the reader is idle creates the 0x28-byte result task (world_quiz_result_task_construct; +0x28; priority 6), hands it the main task's score (world_quiz_result_task_start) and plays track 5 with fade, -> 7; 7 result status 3 -> 8, status 2 (play again) fades out, sets the black screen, destroys the tasks and returns to 0; 8 reports completion. Returns 1 in state 8, otherwise 0. Side effects: game state, tasks, audio, CIP reader, fades. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_update_frame).
Returns word +0x24 of the result task (2 = play again, 3 = leave, as tested by world_quiz_game_update). No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_game_update).

Returns word +0x16ecc of the main quiz task, the value world_quiz_game_update hands to the result screen as the score (medium). No side effects. Callers: 2 (world_quiz_game_update, world_quiz_hud_draw).
Returns byte +0x16ebc of the main quiz task; world_quiz_game_update leaves the play state when it is 1. No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_game_update).
Returns the title task's done byte +0x8c (set when its frame counter reaches the kind's duration). No side effects. Callers: 2 (world_quiz_game_update, world_quiz_main_update).

Stores enable in the task's update-enable byte +0x18 (the update walker only runs tasks with 1). No return value. Side effects: writes the task. Callers: 2 (world_quiz_game_update, world_quiz_main_update).
Returns the archive loader's pending-load counter +0x34. No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_game_update).
Stores enable in game +0x08; while it is 1 world_quiz_game_draw covers the screen with black. No return value. Side effects: writes the game object. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_game_update).

On GE layer 5 disables states 1 and 9, enables blending (state 4, func 0/2/3), sets texture function 0/1 and ambient 0xff000000 and draws a 480x272 sprite at (0, 0). No return value. Side effects: GE layer 5. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_game_draw).

When archive slot 0 is loaded, finds mini_qz_bg0.gim in it and draws it on GE layer 4 (states 1, 9, 4 enabled, white ambient): one 480x256 sprite and two 256x16 strips at y 256 (flip 3, from u 0x1e0 and 0x1f0). The palette (clut level) is the category byte +0x11 minus 1 of the current question record (main task +0x20 + index * 0x18, index from world_quiz_main_get_question_index) once the main task exists, else 0. No return value. Side effects: GE layer 4. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_game_draw).
Returns word +0x16ec0 of the main quiz task, used as the index of the current 0x18-byte question record (medium). No side effects. Callers: 2 (world_quiz_draw_background, world_quiz_hud_draw).

Draws a frame: the background (world_quiz_draw_background), every enabled task (world_quiz_run_task_draws), the screen fade on GE layer 5 (state 1 disabled, system_draw_fade) and, while game +0x08 is 1, the black cover (world_quiz_draw_black_screen). No return value. Side effects: GE display lists. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_draw_frame).

Destroys the task manager and all tasks, terminates the 3D render state, releases the 13 archive slots (world_quiz_loader_release_all via its thunk), deletes the loader (vtable +0x38, slot +8) and clears game +0, frees the CIP buffer +0x0c and releases tracks 0x2d4 and 0x2c8. No return value. Side effects: frees module allocations, audio tracks. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_leave).
Sets the game object's vtable +0x2c to 0x0000f2d0 and stores the object in the singleton 0x0040f3c8. Returns game. Side effects: 0x0040f3c8. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_init).

When game is non-null resets its vtable to 0x0000f2d0, clears the singleton 0x0040f3c8 and frees it when flags > 0. Returns game. Side effects: 0x0040f3c8, may free game. No direct caller (vtable 0x0000f2d0 slot +8).

Completion callback of an archive load: when size is positive, binds the buffer (request +8) as an EHP (container_ehp_bind_with_callback) when its first 3 bytes match the magic at 0x0000e968, decrements the loader's pending counter, stores the buffer into the slot word (request +0), frees the 12-byte request and returns 1; returns 0 when size < 1. Side effects: EHP binding, loader slot and counter, frees the request. No direct caller (passed to container_load_file by world_quiz_loader_load_slot).
Decrements the loader's pending-load counter +0x34. No return value. Side effects: loader +0x34. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_loader_on_file_loaded).
Clears the 13 slot words (+0..+0x33) and the pending counter +0x34. No return value. Side effects: writes the loader. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_game_init).
Stores data into *slot (loader unused). No return value. Side effects: the slot word. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_loader_on_file_loaded).

Returns the loaded data pointer of archive slot slot (loader word slot), 0 while not loaded. No side effects. Callers: 6 (world_quiz_draw_background, world_quiz_wheel_load_parts, world_quiz_title_update, world_quiz_popup_update, ...).

When archive slot slot is empty, takes its {root, path} entry from the table at 0x0000e024 (8 bytes per slot; slot 0 is quiz_data.ehp), gets the file size, allocates a 12-byte request {slot pointer, loader, buffer} and a buffer of that size on the module heap, starts container_load_file with world_quiz_loader_on_file_loaded as completion callback and increments the pending counter +0x34. No return value. Side effects: heap allocations, an asynchronous file load, loader +0x34. Callers: 2 (world_quiz_game_init, world_quiz_game_update).
Zeroes the three words of a load request. No return value. Side effects: writes request. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_loader_load_slot).

Maps save_get_language() 0..5 to archive slot 1..6 (anything else 1); this slot holds the per-language UI layouts and images (mini_qz_title ehf, mini_qz_parts gims). Returns the slot. No side effects. Callers: 5 (world_quiz_game_init, world_quiz_wheel_load_parts, world_quiz_title_update, world_quiz_hud_load_parts, ...).

Maps save_get_language() to archive slot 7..12 (0 -> 7, 1 -> 8, 2 -> 10, 3 -> 9, 4 -> 11, 5 -> 12; note 2 and 3 are swapped relative to the UI slots); this slot is passed as the archive of the mini-game result screen. Returns the slot. No side effects. Callers: 2 (world_quiz_game_update, world_quiz_result_task_start).

When data is non-null, runs the EHP extension handlers on it when its first 3 bytes match the magic at 0x0000e968 (unbinding it), then frees it (operator_delete_array). No return value. Side effects: frees data. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_loader_release_all).

Calls world_quiz_loader_release_data on all 13 slot words (+0..+0x30); the slots themselves are not cleared. No return value. Side effects: frees the loaded archives. No direct caller (reached through its thunk from world_quiz_game_term).

Jump thunk (8 bytes: j 0x00001410; nop) to world_quiz_loader_release_all. Arguments, return value and side effects are those of world_quiz_loader_release_all (documented in docs/subsystems/functions/world.md). Callers: 1 (FUN_0000103c).
Sets the archive loader's vtable +0x38 to 0x0000f2dc. Returns loader. Side effects: writes loader. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_game_init).
When loader is non-null resets its vtable to 0x0000f2dc and frees it when flags > 0. Returns loader. Side effects: may free loader. No direct caller (vtable 0x0000f2dc slot +8).

Initialises the card wheel's fields read by world_quiz_wheel_draw: +0x20 = 800.0 (ring radius / camera distance), +0x24 = 0.0 (spin angle), +0x28 = 10.0 (angle step per card), +0x2c = 170.0 (field-of-view angle), +0x30 = 77.0 (tilt angle), screen centre +0x34/+0x36 = (120, 136), clears +0x38, the gim pointers +0x3c/+0x40, the first index +0x44, the spin flag +0x48 and the images-ready byte +0x3a. No return value. Side effects: writes wheel. No direct caller (hypothesis: the wheel's attach hook in vtable 0x0000f2e8, medium).

Once the language UI slot is loaded, looks up mini_qz_parts01.gim into wheel +0x3c and mini_qz_parts02.gim into +0x40 when they are still null. No return value. Side effects: wheel +0x3c/+0x40. No direct caller (hypothesis: the wheel's update entry in vtable 0x0000f2e8, medium).
Returns game word +0, the archive loader. No side effects. Callers: 5 (world_quiz_wheel_load_parts, world_quiz_title_update, world_quiz_hud_load_parts, world_quiz_popup_update, ...).
Returns the game singleton 0x0040f3c8. No side effects. Callers: 10 (world_quiz_wheel_load_parts, world_quiz_wheel_draw, world_quiz_wheel_draw_card, world_quiz_title_update, ...).

column2: void * world_quiz_wheel_draw_number(void *wheel, void *list, short *pos, int value)
column3: Draws a number badge on a wheel card: clamps value to 999, counts its digits (1-3), projects one badge quad (template 0x0000e14c, texture wheel +0x40 = mini_qz_parts02) and one quad per digit 30 px apart (digit UVs from world_quiz_get_parts01_rect, digit table 0x0000e994; texture wheel +0x3c = mini_qz_parts01) with the wheel perspective (scale = (cos(fov/2) * 480 / sin(fov/2)) / (pos z + radius + that), centre wheel +0x34/+0x36) into inline vertex data and issues sprite draws. Returns the advanced display list (Ghidra shows no return value; the caller uses v0). Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_wheel_draw_card), which passes the record's short +0x14 as value (hidden a3 argument, hypothesis medium).
Copies a 14-byte through-mode vertex (u, v shorts, colour word, x, y, z shorts). Returns dst. Side effects: writes dst. Callers: 2 (world_quiz_wheel_draw_number, world_quiz_wheel_draw_card).

Projects three 4-vertex quads for one wheel card at the 3D position pos (templates 0x0000e08c card art, 0x0000e0cc frame, 0x0000e10c overlay) with the wheel perspective; draws the frame with mini_qz_parts01 (wheel +0x3c), then the card art of record +4 (u16 card id) from the CIP reader when its image is cached (card_db_cip_write_image_texture); when record +0x12 is 1 draws the overlay quad and, if record short +0x14 is positive, the number badge (world_quiz_wheel_draw_number). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_wheel_draw).
Returns game +0x10, the card8 CIP reader (0 when closed). No side effects. Callers: 2 (world_quiz_wheel_draw, world_quiz_wheel_draw_card).

Draw entry of the card wheel: when the CIP reader is ready, both parts gims are loaded and the main task exists, computes ten card positions on a vertical ring (radius wheel +0x20, angle from +0x24 - 2 * step +0x28, tilt +0x30) for question indices +0x44 - 2 .. +0x44 + 7 (wrapping to -1 past 0xde1), sorts them back to front by z, draws each valid one (world_quiz_wheel_draw_card with record main +0x20 + index * 0x18) on GE layer 4 with linear filtering, sets +0x3a when every visible card's art is cached and, while the spin flag +0x48 is set and all art is ready, turns the ring by 1 degree per frame until a full step, then clears the flag and advances +0x44. No return value. Side effects: GE layer 4, wheel +0x24/+0x3a/+0x44/+0x48. No direct caller (hypothesis: the wheel's draw entry in vtable 0x0000f2e8, medium).
Returns game +0x18, the main quiz task. No side effects. Callers: 2 (world_quiz_wheel_draw, world_quiz_hud_draw).
Empty function (hypothesis: an empty entry of the wheel vtable 0x0000f2e8, medium). No return value. No side effects. No direct caller.
Runs the base task constructor and sets the card wheel's vtable +0x1c to 0x0000f2e8. Returns wheel. Side effects: writes wheel. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_create_tasks).

When wheel is non-null resets its vtable to 0x0000f2e8, runs the base destructor without freeing and frees it when flags > 0. Returns wheel. Side effects: may free wheel. No direct caller (vtable 0x0000f2e8 slot +8).

Allocates a 0x90-byte title task (world_quiz_title_construct), attaches it with its hook at priorities 5/5 for kind 4, otherwise 3/3 before equal priorities, and sets its kind and auto-delete flag (world_quiz_title_set_kind). Returns the task (0 on allocation failure). Side effects: heap allocation, task lists. Callers: 3 (world_quiz_game_update, world_quiz_main_judge_answer, world_quiz_main_update).
Detaches task with its detach hook and deletes it through vtable slot +8 (flag 1). No return value. Side effects: frees the task. Callers: 2 (world_quiz_game_update, world_quiz_main_update).

Clears title +0x20..+0x7f, sets the EHF player pointer +0x80 to 0, kind +0x84 to 5, duration +0x88 to 0, the done and auto-delete bytes +0x8c/+0x8d to 0, and sets bit 0x10000 in +0x2c. No return value. Side effects: writes the title. No direct caller (hypothesis: the title's attach hook, medium).

column2: void world_quiz_title_set_kind(void *title, int kind, uchar auto_delete)
column3: Stores kind (+0x84) and auto_delete (+0x8d) and the display duration in frames (+0x88): kind 0 -> 0x1b, 1 and 4 -> 0x4b, 2 and 3 -> 0x11 (other kinds leave it). No return value. Side effects: writes the title. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_create_title).

column2: void world_quiz_title_set_offset(int x, int y, void *title)
column3: Stores x at title +0x34 and y at +0x38 (note the task is the third argument). No return value. Side effects: writes the title. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_main_judge_answer).

Update entry of the title task: on first use, once the language UI slot is loaded, finds the EHF named by the table 0x0000ea18[kind] (entry 0 is mini_qz_title.ehf), allocates its work area, initialises the EHF player (+0x80) and seeks frame 0; then increments the frame counter +0x20 until it reaches the duration +0x88, after which it sets the done byte +0x8c and, when auto-delete is set, detaches and deletes itself. No return value. Side effects: heap allocation, title fields, may free the title. No direct caller (vtable entry).

On GE layer 4 disables states 1 and 9, enables blending (0/2/3), texture function 0/1 and white ambient and draws a 480x272 sprite at (0, 0), a full-screen white cover. No return value. Side effects: GE layer 4. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_title_draw).

Draw entry of the title task: when its EHF player +0x80 exists, first covers the screen in white for kind 0 (world_quiz_title_draw_white_screen), then draws the player on GE layer 4 with the parameter block at +0x20 (frame +0x20, offsets +0x34/+0x38) between ui_ehf_begin_draw and ui_ehf_end_draw. No return value. Side effects: GE layer 4. No direct caller (vtable 0x0000f304).

Frees the title's EHF work area +0x80 (operator_delete_array) and clears it. No return value. Side effects: heap free, title +0x80. No direct caller (hypothesis: the title's detach hook in vtable 0x0000f304, medium).
Returns the title's frame counter +0x20 (the first word of its EHF parameter block). No side effects. Callers: 2 (world_quiz_game_update, world_quiz_main_update).
Runs the base task constructor and sets the title task's vtable +0x1c to 0x0000f304. Returns title. Side effects: writes title. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_create_title).

When title is non-null resets its vtable to 0x0000f304, runs the base destructor without freeing and frees it when flags > 0. Returns title. Side effects: may free title. No direct caller (vtable 0x0000f304 slot +8).

Clears the HUD task's image and table pointers +0x20 (parts01), +0x24 (parts02), +0x28 (icon01) and +0x2c (string table). No return value. Side effects: writes hud. No direct caller (hypothesis: the HUD's attach hook in vtable 0x0000f320, medium).

Returns the member name of the quiz string table for save_get_language(): 0 quiz_strtbl_j.bin, 1 _e, 2 _g, 3 _f, 4 _i, 5 _s (strings at 0x0000ea2c..0x0000ea90); null for other values. No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_hud_load_parts).

Once the language UI slot is loaded, fills the still-null HUD pointers: +0x20 mini_qz_parts01.gim, +0x24 mini_qz_parts02.gim, +0x2c the language string table (world_quiz_get_strtbl_name) from that slot, and +0x28 mini_qz_icon01.gim from archive slot 0 when it is loaded. No return value. Side effects: hud +0x20..+0x2c. No direct caller (hypothesis: the HUD's update entry in vtable 0x0000f320, medium).

Draw entry of the HUD task: when all four HUD resources and the main task exist, enables the font shadow and draws on GE layer 4: the category header for the current question's category byte +0x11 (world_quiz_hud_draw_category at 0x89, 6), the correct/answered tally (world_quiz_hud_draw_tally at 0x89, 0xf3), the remaining time in seconds rounded up ((frames + 29) / 30, world_quiz_hud_draw_timer at 0x140, 6), the score (world_quiz_hud_draw_score at 0x136, 0xf3), the two answer markers (parts01 sprites 5/6 at 0xc3, 0x66 and 7/8 at 0xc3, 0x8f, the second of each pair when that choice was pressed), and both answer choices at (0xcc, 0x25) and (0xcc, 0x91) with the drawer for the question type record +0: 0 card name, 1 card frame, 2 level, 3 ATK, 4 DEF, 5 spell/trap icon, 6 attribute, 7 race (values from record +0x08 and +0x0c). No return value. Side effects: GE layer 4, font shadow state. No direct caller (vtable 0x0000f320).
Returns byte +0x16edc + choice of the main task (1 while answer 0 or 1 has just been chosen; cleared when the next question comes up). No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_hud_draw).
Returns the remaining play time in frames, main task +0x16ec8 (0xe10 = 60 s at start). No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_hud_draw).
Returns the number of answered questions, main task +0x16ed8. No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_hud_draw).
Returns the number of correct answers, main task +0x16ed0. No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_hud_draw).

column2: void * world_quiz_hud_draw_name_choice(void *hud, void *list, int x, int y, ushort *text)
column3: When text is non-null draws it as a card-name answer into list through the font's external-list mode: white, scale 14 (the horizontal scale is replaced by the result of 0x000033b8 for width 0x10d, hypothesis: a fit-to-width scale, medium), centred in a 269-pixel box at (x, y + 0x24) with ui_draw_level_badge_text_fit; for every language other than Japanese font flag 0x4000 is set around the call. Returns the advanced display list (list unchanged when text is null). Side effects: the display list, font state. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_hud_draw).

column2: void ui_draw_level_badge_text_fit(int x, int y, int width, void *text)
column3: Pixel wrapper: system_font_draw_text_fit_width(x << 6, y << 6, width << 6, text, -1) (a tail call, so Ghidra shows an empty body). No return value. Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 2 (world_quiz_hud_draw_name_choice, world_quiz_hud_draw_race_choice). Same code as BOOT ui_draw_level_badge_text_fit.

Pixel wrapper: tail-jumps to system_font_fit_scale_to_width(max_width << 6, text) (same code as BOOT.BIN system_font_fit_scale_to_width_px). Returns the horizontal font scale at which text fits max_width pixels; the caller uses it as the font scale of the answer text. No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_hud_draw_name_choice).

column2: void * world_quiz_hud_draw_frame_choice(void *hud, void *list, int x, int y, int frame)
column3: Draws a card-frame answer: maps the frame value to an atlas sprite and string-table word (0 -> 9/7, 1 -> 10/4, 2 -> 11/8, 3 -> 12/5, 7 -> 13/6, 8 -> 14/10, 10 -> 15/9; other values keep sprite 9 and an undefined word), binds parts02 for sprite 15 and parts01 otherwise, draws the sprite centred in the 269x87 answer box from the table 0x0000e190 and the word (card_db_get_dictionary_word on the string table +0x2c) centred below it at scale 20. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list, font state. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_hud_draw).

column2: void ui_list_window_draw_text(int x, int y, void *text)
column3: Draws text from pixel x to the right screen edge: system_font_draw_text(x << 6, y << 6, (480 - x) << 6, text) (tail call; Ghidra shows only the argument arithmetic). No return value. Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 7 (world_quiz_hud_draw_frame_choice, world_quiz_hud_draw_level_choice, world_quiz_hud_draw_atk_choice, world_quiz_hud_draw_number_text, ...). Same code as BOOT ui_list_window_draw_text.

column2: void * world_quiz_hud_draw_level_choice(void *hud, void *list, int x, int y, int level)
column3: Draws a level answer: level star sprites (icon01 atlas entry 0x26, spacing from 0x0000e608) centred in the 269-pixel box, and below them the string-table word given by the 13-entry table at 0x0000eae0 indexed by level, white at scale 16, centred. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list, font state. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_hud_draw).

column2: void * world_quiz_hud_draw_atk_choice(void *hud, void *list, int x, int y, int atk)
column3: Draws an ATK answer: string-table word 1 (the ATK label) at scale 20 centred in a 0x95-pixel box at y + 0x21, then the value to its right with world_quiz_hud_draw_number_text, or word 0x24 (the unknown-value mark) 80 pixels further when atk is 0xffff. Returns the advanced display list (Ghidra drops the final return). Side effects: the display list, font state. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_hud_draw).

column2: void * world_quiz_hud_draw_def_choice(void *hud, void *list, int x, int y, int def)
column3: Same as world_quiz_hud_draw_atk_choice with string-table word 2 (the DEF label). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list, font state. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_hud_draw).

column2: void * world_quiz_hud_draw_icon_choice(void *hud, void *list, int x, int y, int icon)
column3: Draws a spell/trap icon answer: icon01 atlas sprite (icon 0 -> 0x1c, 1 -> 0x16, 2..6 -> 0x17..0x1b) centred in the 269x87 box and card_db_get_icon_name(icon) centred below it at scale 20. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list, font state. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_hud_draw).

column2: void * world_quiz_hud_draw_attribute_choice(void *hud, void *list, int x, int y, int attribute)
column3: Draws an attribute answer: icon01 atlas sprite (attribute 1..6 -> 0x1d..0x22, 7 -> 0x25, 8 -> 0x23, 9 -> 0x24, else 0x16) centred in the box and card_db_get_attribute_name(attribute) centred below at scale 20. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list, font state. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_hud_draw).

column2: void * world_quiz_hud_draw_race_choice(void *hud, void *list, int x, int y, int race)
column3: Draws a race (monster type) answer: icon01 atlas sprite race - 1 centred in the box and card_db_get_race_name(race) below it at scale 20, centred when narrower than 0xd2 pixels, otherwise at x + 0x1e fitted to 0xd1 pixels (ui_draw_level_badge_text_fit). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list, font state. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_hud_draw).

column2: void * world_quiz_draw_parts01_sprite(void *hud, void *list, int x, int y, int index)
column3: Draws entry index of the 16-byte sprite table at 0x0000e190 (floats u, v, width, height; used with mini_qz_parts01.gim) as a sprite at (x, y). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 8 (world_quiz_hud_draw, world_quiz_hud_draw_frame_choice, world_quiz_draw_number3, world_quiz_hud_draw_tally, ...).

column2: void * world_quiz_draw_parts02_sprite(void *hud, void *list, int x, int y, int index)
column3: Draws entry index of the sprite table at 0x0000e360 (used with mini_qz_parts02.gim) at (x, y). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 2 (world_quiz_hud_draw_category, world_quiz_hud_draw_timer).

column2: void * world_quiz_draw_icon01_sprite(void *hud, void *list, int x, int y, int index)
column3: Draws entry index of the sprite table at 0x0000e3a0 (used with mini_qz_icon01.gim) at (x, y). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 4 (world_quiz_hud_draw_level_choice, world_quiz_hud_draw_icon_choice, world_quiz_hud_draw_attribute_choice, world_quiz_hud_draw_race_choice).

column2: void * world_quiz_draw_number3(void *hud, void *list, int x, int y, int value)
column3: Draws value clamped to 999 as up to three digit sprites (parts01 atlas entries 0x10 + digit), suppressing leading zeros but always drawing the last digit; the pen advances by the digit width - 2. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 2 (world_quiz_hud_draw_tally, world_quiz_hud_draw_timer).

column2: void * world_quiz_hud_draw_category(void *hud, void *list, int x, int y, int category)
column3: Draws the category header: parts02 atlas entry 0 at (x, y), then the parts01 atlas entry named by the 10-entry table 0x0000eb14[category] at x + 100 (x + 0x6f for language 3, x + 0x69 for language 4). Returns the advanced display list (Ghidra drops the final return). Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_hud_draw).

column2: void * world_quiz_hud_draw_tally(void *hud, void *list, int x, int y, int correct, int answered)
column3: Draws a label sprite (its index is passed in a register Ghidra hides, hypothesis), then correct as up to three digits, a slash sprite (parts01 entry 0x1a) and answered as up to three digits. The sixth argument travels in t1. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_hud_draw).

column2: void * world_quiz_hud_draw_timer(void *hud, void *list, int x, int y, int seconds)
column3: Draws the time label (parts02 entry 3 at x - 0x1a; x - 0x24 for language 2, x - 0x28 for language 4), seconds as up to three digits and the unit sprite (parts01 entry 0x1b). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_hud_draw).

column2: void * world_quiz_draw_number5(void *hud, void *list, int x, int y, int value)
column3: Draws value clamped to 99999 as up to five digit sprites (parts01 entries 0x10 + digit), leading zeros suppressed. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_hud_draw_score).

column2: void world_quiz_hud_draw_number_text(void *hud, void *list, int x, int y, int value)
column3: Draws value clamped to 99999 as text: each significant digit (leading zeros suppressed, last always drawn) is the string-table word from the 10-entry table at 0x0000eb3c, drawn with ui_list_window_draw_text 20 pixels apart inside one external font list. No return value (the list is closed with system_font_end_external_list). Side effects: the display list. Callers: 2 (world_quiz_hud_draw_atk_choice, world_quiz_hud_draw_def_choice).

column2: void * world_quiz_hud_draw_score(void *hud, void *list, int x, int y, int score)
column3: Draws the score label sprite (at x - 7 with entry 2 for language 4, x - 5 for language 2, else x; the index for the other languages is in a register Ghidra hides) and the score as up to five digits at x + the offset 0x0000e1b8. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_hud_draw).
Returns the address of entry index of the parts01 sprite table (0x0000e190 + index * 0x10). No side effects. Callers: 2 (world_quiz_wheel_draw_number, world_quiz_popup_draw_number).
Returns the address of entry index of the parts02 sprite table (0x0000e360 + index * 0x10). No side effects. Callers: 2 (world_quiz_wheel_draw_number, world_quiz_popup_draw_number).
Empty function (hypothesis: an empty entry of the HUD vtable 0x0000f320, medium). No return value. No side effects. No direct caller.
Runs the base task constructor and sets the HUD task's vtable +0x1c to 0x0000f320. Returns hud. Side effects: writes hud. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_create_tasks).

When hud is non-null resets its vtable to 0x0000f320, runs the base destructor without freeing and frees it when flags > 0. Returns hud. Side effects: may free hud. No direct caller (vtable 0x0000f320 slot +8).

Resets the main quiz task: state +0x16eb8 = 0, question index +0x16ec0 = 0, spin latch +0x16ec4 = 0, time +0x16ec8 = 0xe10 frames (60 s), score +0x16ecc, correct +0x16ed0, combo +0x16ed4, answered +0x16ed8, finished byte +0x16ebc, title pointer +0x16ee0, timer +0x16ee4 and the pressed bytes +0x16edc/+0x16edd to 0; clears the 3554 question records (+0x20, 0x14d30 bytes) and the 2-byte-per-card table (+0x14d50, 0x2166 bytes); counts the eligible cards with ids 0xe88..0x1f3a (world_quiz_is_card_eligible) into +0x16ee8; runs world_quiz_shuffle_cards (hypothesis: builds the shuffled card order, medium) and generates question 0 (world_quiz_make_question). No return value. Side effects: the main task. No direct caller (hypothesis: the main task's attach hook in vtable 0x0000f33c, medium).

Judges answer choice (0 upper, 1 lower) for the current record (main + 0x20 + index * 0x18): when it equals the correct slot +0x06 sets the record's correct byte +0x12 and creates title kind 3, otherwise clears it and creates title kind 2 with auto-delete; offsets the title to y -54.0 (choice 0) or +54.0 (choice 1). Increments the answered count +0x16ed8. On a correct answer: correct count +0x16ed0 + 1, score +0x16ecc += combo +0x16ed4 + the record's points byte +0x10, stores the combo in the record's short +0x14, creates a combo pop-up at (0x152, 0x73 or 0xdf) when the combo is positive (world_quiz_create_combo_popup), increments the combo and plays sound 0x7abd. On a wrong answer: combo = 0, time -= 150 frames (5 s, clamped at 0), sound 0x7abe. No return value. Side effects: the main task and question record, tasks created, sounds. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_main_play_step).

One frame of play: returns 0 when the wheel task does not exist. When the wheel has just stopped spinning (latch +0x16ec4 was 1), advances the question index +0x16ec0, clears the pressed bytes and plays sound 0x7ac4 when the new question's category +0x11 is higher than the previous one's. While the wheel is not spinning, a press of Up or Triangle (0x1010) answers choice 0 and Down or Cross (0x4040) choice 1: marks the pressed byte, starts the wheel spin, judges the answer (world_quiz_main_judge_answer) and generates the next question (world_quiz_make_question with index + 1). Stores the spin state in the latch, zeroes the time when power flags 0x70000 are set, and, unless the UMD reports bit 0x20 while the wheel's art is still loading, counts the time +0x16ec8 down by one frame with a tick sound each second (0x7ac1/0x7ac0 alternating; 0x7ac3 in the last 10 s). Returns 1 (playing sound 0x7abf) when the time reaches 0, else 0. Side effects: the main task, wheel spin, sounds. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_main_update).
Returns the wheel byte +0x3a, set by world_quiz_wheel_draw when the art of every visible card is cached. No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_main_play_step).
Sets the wheel spin flag +0x48 to 1 (the wheel turns one step to the next question). No return value. Side effects: wheel +0x48. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_main_play_step).
Returns the wheel spin flag +0x48. No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_main_play_step).
Returns game +0x24, the card wheel task. No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_main_play_step).

Update entry of the main quiz task, state +0x16eb8: 0 when the game state is 5 creates title kind 1 (start banner; +0x16ee0), plays sound 0x7abf, -> 1; 1 when that title is done destroys it, clears the power flags, -> 2; 2 runs world_quiz_main_play_step and, when time is up, destroys any title, creates title kind 4 (finish), sets the timer +0x16ee4 = 60, -> 3; 3 holds the title at frame 0x14 (update disabled) until Circle (0x2000) is pressed, then resumes it, -> 4; 4 when the title is done -> 5; 5 sets the finished byte +0x16ebc. No return value. Side effects: the main task, tasks created and destroyed, sounds, power flags. No direct caller (vtable 0x0000f33c).
Returns game +0x04, the state of world_quiz_game_update. No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_main_update).
Empty function (hypothesis: an empty entry of the main-task vtable 0x0000f33c, medium). No return value. No side effects. No direct caller.

When a title task is held at +0x16ee0, detaches it with its hook, deletes it and clears the field. No return value. Side effects: frees the title, main +0x16ee0. No direct caller (hypothesis: the main task's detach hook, medium).

Returns the address of question record index (main + 0x20 + index * 0x18). Record layout: +0 type (0 name, 1 frame, 2 level, 3 ATK, 4 DEF, 5 icon, 6 attribute, 7 race), +4 card id (u16), +6 correct slot (0/1), +8 and +0xc the two choice values, +0x10 points, +0x11 category, +0x12 answered-correctly byte, +0x14 combo at answer time. No side effects. Callers: 3 (world_quiz_draw_background, world_quiz_wheel_draw, world_quiz_hud_draw).

Fills a name question: the correct slot (record +6) gets card_db_get_name(record card id), the other slot the name of a different random eligible card (world_quiz_pick_random_card). Returns 1. Side effects: writes the record. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_make_question).

Fills a card-frame question: the correct slot gets card_db_get_frame(card id); the other slot a random frame from the 7-entry table 0x0000eb64 that differs from it and is not its look-alike pair (frames 3 and 8 exclude each other, as do 0 and 1). Returns 1. Side effects: writes the record. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_make_question).

Fills a level question for monsters with level >= 1: correct slot = level, other slot = level * 3 for levels below 4, level * 2 for 4-5, level / 2 from 6. Returns 1, or 0 when the card is not a monster or has no level. Side effects: writes the record. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_make_question).

Fills an ATK question for monsters with ATK >= 0 (card_db_get_atk_or_unknown): correct slot = ATK, other slot = 0xffff (unknown) when ATK is 0, 0 when ATK is 0xffff, ATK * 3 below 2400, else ATK / 2. Returns 1, or 0 for non-monsters and negative values. Side effects: writes the record. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_make_question).

Same as world_quiz_make_atk_question for DEF (card_db_get_def_or_unknown), with the threshold 2000. Returns 1, or 0 for non-monsters and negative values. Side effects: writes the record. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_make_question).

Fills a spell/trap icon question: fails (returns 0) when card_db_get_icon(card id) is 0; otherwise the correct slot gets the icon and the other slot a different icon drawn at random from the 6-entry table 0x0000eb80. Returns 1 on success. Side effects: writes the record. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_make_question).

Fills an attribute question for monsters: the correct slot gets card_db_get_attribute(card id), the other slot a different attribute from the 8-entry table 0x0000eb98 (rand & 7). Returns 1, or 0 for non-monsters. Side effects: writes the record. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_make_question).

Fills a race (monster type) question for monsters with race 1..0x15: the correct slot gets the race, the other slot a different random race 1..0x15. Returns 1, or 0 for non-monsters and races outside 1..0x15. Side effects: writes the record. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_make_question).
True for the nine card ids the quiz never uses: 0xea8, 0xeb3, 0xecb, 0xecd, 0xece, 0x1386, 0x1387, 0x1388 and 0x1b4d. No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_is_card_eligible).

True when card_id may be asked about: card_db_is_valid, race not 0x16, not a token, outside 0x1ca4..0x1cad and not in world_quiz_is_excluded_card. No side effects. Callers: 3 (world_quiz_main_reset, world_quiz_pick_random_card, world_quiz_shuffle_cards).

Draws random card ids 0xe88 + rand % 0x10b3 (0xe88..0x1f3a) until one is eligible (world_quiz_is_card_eligible). Returns that id. No side effects beyond the random generator. Callers: 2 (world_quiz_shuffle_cards, world_quiz_make_name_question).

For each of the eligible-card count (+0x16ee8) question records, picks a random eligible card and, when its used bit (bit 0 of byte +0x14d51 + (id - 0xe88) * 2) is already set, probes upwards (wrapping 0x1f3a -> 0xe88) to the next eligible unused id; stores the id in the record's card field (+0x24 + i * 0x18, record +4) and sets its used bit. Stops early if an id of 0x1f3b or more appears. No return value. Side effects: the question records and the used-card table. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_main_reset).

Generates question record index (its card id is already set): the type pool and the points/category bytes (+0x10/+0x11, both set to the tier) depend on the current combo +0x16ed4: below 6 type 0 (name), tier 1; 6-10 a random type from the 2-entry table 0x0000ebb8, tier 2; 11-15 3 entries at 0x0000ebc0, tier 3; 16-20 4 entries at 0x0000ebcc, tier 4; 21-25 5 entries at 0x0000ebdc, tier 5; 26-30 6 entries at 0x0000ebf0, tier 6; 31-35 7 entries at 0x0000ec08, tier 7; from 36 any type 0..7, tier 8. Picks a random correct slot (+6) and calls the type's generator (world_quiz_make_name_question ... world_quiz_make_race_question), retrying with a new type until one succeeds. No return value. Side effects: writes the record. Callers: 2 (world_quiz_main_reset, world_quiz_main_play_step).
Runs the base task constructor and sets the main quiz task's vtable +0x1c to 0x0000f33c. Returns main_task. Side effects: writes the task. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_create_tasks).

When main_task is non-null resets its vtable to 0x0000f33c, runs the base destructor without freeing and frees it when flags > 0. Returns main_task. Side effects: may free the task. No direct caller (vtable 0x0000f33c slot +8).

Allocates a 0x44-byte pop-up task (world_quiz_popup_construct), attaches it with its hook at priorities 4/4 before equal priorities and initialises it with pos and value (world_quiz_popup_init). Returns the task. Side effects: heap allocation, task lists. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_main_judge_answer), which passes the combo count as value (hidden a1 argument, hypothesis medium).
Empty function (hypothesis: an empty entry of the pop-up vtable 0x0000f358, medium). No return value. No side effects. No direct caller.

Clears the gim pointers +0x20/+0x24, sets the start delay +0x30 = 10 frames, copies pos to +0x28, stores value at +0x2c, scale +0x34 = 2.0, alpha +0x38 = 1.0 and the per-frame scale and alpha steps +0x3c/+0x40 from 0x0000e6f4/0x0000e6f0. No return value. Side effects: writes popup. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_create_combo_popup).
Copies two shorts (x, y). Returns dst. Side effects: writes dst. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_popup_init).

Update entry of the pop-up: once the language UI slot is loaded, fills mini_qz_parts01.gim (+0x20) and mini_qz_parts02.gim (+0x24) if null; counts the delay +0x30 down and, after it, adds the scale step to +0x34 and subtracts the alpha step from +0x38; when the alpha goes negative detaches and deletes itself. No return value. Side effects: popup fields, may free the popup. No direct caller (vtable 0x0000f358).

column2: void * world_quiz_popup_draw_number(void *popup, void *list, short *pos, int value)
column3: Draws value (clamped to 999, 1-3 digits) scaled by popup +0x34 around pos: the parts02 badge (atlas entry 1) to the left, then each digit as the parts01 entry from the 10-entry table 0x0000ec4c, 19 pixels apart before scaling, vertically centred 11.5 pixels up. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_popup_draw).

Draw entry of the pop-up: when both gims are loaded, sets up GE layer 4 (blending, linear filtering, lighting off) with an ambient colour of alpha +0x38 * 255 (clamped to 255) and draws world_quiz_popup_draw_number at +0x28 with value +0x2c. No return value. Side effects: GE layer 4. No direct caller (vtable 0x0000f358).
Empty function (hypothesis: an empty entry of the pop-up vtable 0x0000f358, medium). No return value. No side effects. No direct caller.
Runs the base task constructor and sets the pop-up's vtable +0x1c to 0x0000f358. Returns popup. Side effects: writes popup. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_create_combo_popup).

When popup is non-null resets its vtable to 0x0000f358, runs the base destructor without freeing and frees it when flags > 0. Returns popup. Side effects: may free popup. No direct caller (vtable 0x0000f358 slot +8).
Empty function (hypothesis: an empty entry of the result-task vtable 0x0000f374, medium). No return value. No side effects. No direct caller.

Stores score as a one-word score block at result_task +0x20, clears the status +0x24 and creates the shared mini-game result screen on the module heap with the language result slot as archive and game index 3 (ui_quiz_result_create(heap, archive, 3, +0x20)), which records the score as mini-game record 6 with DP score / 10. No return value. Side effects: the result block 0x0040f3cc, save records, DP, EXP, the world mini-game score. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_game_update).

Update entry of the result task: stores the return value of ui_quiz_result_update (1 running, 2 play again, 3 leave) in +0x24, which world_quiz_game_update polls. No return value. Side effects: result_task +0x24, the result screen. No direct caller (vtable 0x0000f374).
Draw entry of the result task: draws the result screen (ui_quiz_result_draw) into GE layer 4. No return value. Side effects: GE layer 4. No direct caller (vtable 0x0000f374).

column2: void ui_quiz_result_create(void *heap, void *archive, int game, uint *score)
column3: Allocates the 0x2c4-byte mini-game result block from heap (pointer 0x0040f3cc), clears it, stores heap (+0), initialises its menu context (+0x54) with archive, stores the game index (+0x20), applies the score when given (ui_quiz_result_apply_score) and initialises the screen (ui_quiz_result_init). No return value. Side effects: heap allocation, 0x0040f3cc, save (through apply_score). Callers: 1 (world_quiz_result_task_start), which passes game 3. Copy of rel_title ui_mini_result_create.

When the result block 0x0040f3cc exists, resets its list window (+0x1a4), frees it on its heap and clears the pointer. No return value. Side effects: heap free, 0x0040f3cc. Callers: 1 (its thunk). Copy of rel_title ui_mini_result_destroy.

Scores a finished mini-game into the result block 0x0040f3cc and the save, exactly as rel_title ui_mini_result_apply_score: stores the score values (+0x28 / +0x2c / +0x40) and the main score in world_get_minigame_score(); base DP (+0x30) per game 0 score / 50, 1 / 150, 2 score / 2 plus ceil(score[1] / 100) when score[2] is set, 3 / 10, 4 score[1] * 20 + score[2] * 150, 5 / 50, 6 / 10; each new record (records 0, 1, 2+3, 6, 5+4, 7, 8 for games 0-6) adds 200 DP (+0x34), stores it and sets +0x44/+0x46 and the save record-table byte +0xec + record; total +0x38, EXP +0x3c = total / 25, save_add_dp, save_add_duelist_exp and 400 more DP on a level up; games 3 and 4 store the from-story flag +0x1c (ui_quiz_result_is_from_story). rel_quiz passes game 3 (record 6, DP score / 10). No return value. Side effects: the result block, save records, DP, EXP, the world score. Callers: 1 (ui_quiz_result_create). Copy of rel_title ui_mini_result_apply_score.

Binds the result screen's context layouts (0: mode 1 frames 0..0x10, 1: mode 2 frames 0..0x1df) and images 0 and 1 in the context at block 0x0040f3cc + 0x54, sets step +0xc = 1 and starts a 16-frame black fade in. No return value. Side effects: the result block, fade. Callers: 1 (ui_quiz_result_create). Copy of rel_title ui_mini_result_init.

Returns ui_quiz_result_update_main() while mode +8 of the block 0x0040f3cc is 0, otherwise 1. Side effects: through the update. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_result_task_update). Copy of rel_title ui_mini_result_update.

Step handler of the result screen (+0xc): 0/1 wait for the fade, 2 waits for the intro, 3 handles input, 4 updates the message window, 5 reads layout 0's frame, 6 returns the outcome +0x24 (2 play again or 3 leave). Returns 1 while running, 0 for unknown steps. Side effects: through the handlers. Callers: 1 (ui_quiz_result_update). Copy of rel_title ui_mini_result_update_main.

Step 2: when context layout 0 reaches frame 0x10 switches it to the loop 0x11..0x60 (mode 2); from frame 0x10 on sets step 3. No return value. Side effects: the layout, step. Callers: 1 (ui_quiz_result_update_main). Copy of rel_title ui_mini_result_wait_intro.

Step 3: on a face button (ui_quiz_result_poll_face_buttons): when launched from the story (+0x1c == 1) sets outcome 3, fades the BGM out over 600, plays layout 0 frames 0x61..0x65, step 5 and a 16-frame black fade out; otherwise step 4, outcome 3 and opens a three-choice modal message window with mini_result string 0xd (ui_quiz_menu_ctx_open_message_window on window +0x1a4). No return value. Side effects: the block, window, BGM, fade. Callers: 1 (ui_quiz_result_update_main). Copy of rel_title ui_mini_result_handle_input.

True when any face button (pad pressed bits 0xf000) was pressed, playing sound 0x7a05. Side effects: sound. Callers: 1 (ui_quiz_result_handle_input). Copy of rel_title ui_mini_result_poll_face_buttons.

Step 4: updates the window +0x1a4; result 2 sets the outcome +0x24 = 2 (play again), 3 or -2 sets 3; when the window has closed (state byte +0x28d == 6) plays layout 0 frames 0x36..0x65, sets step 5, starts a black fade out and fades the BGM. No return value. Side effects: the block, layout, fade, BGM. Callers: 1 (ui_quiz_result_update_main). Copy of rel_title ui_mini_result_update_message_window.

Step 5 handler: reads the frame of context layout 0 and discards it (no side effects; the name follows rel_title, hypothesis confidence low for its intent). Callers: 1 (ui_quiz_result_update_main). Copy of rel_title ui_mini_result_is_layout_frame_101.

Draws the result screen: context layout 1, layout 0 from step 2, the header, panels and labels/values, the message window centred at step 4; drives the fades (step 5 -> 6 and step 1 -> 2 when system_draw_fade finishes). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list, step. Callers: 1 (world_quiz_result_task_draw). Copy of rel_title ui_mini_result_draw.

At steps 3 and 4, with context image 1 bound, resets the sprite state and draws its panel part 0xd at (0x70, 8). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_quiz_result_draw). Copy of rel_title ui_mini_result_draw_header.

With context image 0 bound draws the result panels: border box (0x3e, 0x3d, 0x165 x 0xa4), two sections at y 0x40 and 0x79 with title bar and value box (nine-slice colours 1 and 4) and two rows each (colour 3 label box 0x10d x 0x10, colour 1 value box 0x49 x 0x10, plus the new-record mark part 0xc at (0x14a, y + 3) in the first section when +0x44/+0x46 is set), two three-slice bars with value boxes at y 0xb3/0xc8 and the bottom bar (colour 8, y 0x100, 0x1e2 x 0x12). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_quiz_result_draw). Copy of rel_title ui_mini_result_draw_panels.

Draws the result texts from mini_result_<l>.bin: section titles 1/3 and value headers 2/5 (white, scale 0xe), row labels by game (+0x20: 4 for games 0, 1, 3, 5, 6; 6/7 for game 2; 0x13/0x14 for game 4, the second only when +0x40 is set; second section 8 and 9 with unit 0xe in cyan), the totals 10 and 11 with units 0xe/0xf, the centred footer 0xc at y 0x102, then the values (ui_quiz_result_draw_values). Returns the advanced display list (Ghidra drops it). Side effects: the display list, font state. Callers: 1 (ui_quiz_result_draw). Copy of rel_title ui_mini_result_draw_labels.

Draws the six result values (+0x28..+0x3c) right-aligned at x 0x155 with digit glyph strings from 0x15 (ui_quiz_menu_ctx_draw_number): rows at y 0x54/0x67, 0x8d/0xa0 and 0xb9/0xce (19 or 21 pixels apart), widths 0x47 or 0x33, at least 6 digits for the first two and 5 for the others; the second value only for game 2 (as a time, mode 2) and game 4 (when +0x40 is set). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_quiz_result_draw_labels). Copy of rel_title ui_mini_result_draw_values.

True when the mini-game scene (0x15 for game 4, 0x18 for game 3, 0 otherwise) was called from scene 2 (system_scene_get_caller); false when called from scene 0xd (the title) or anything else. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_quiz_result_apply_score). Copy of rel_title ui_mini_result_is_from_story.
